routing_warnings.description: The request for raw files and the final PDF concerns the separate TPEC delivery-artifact Requirement.
The confirmation of final PDFs and original design files concerns the separate TPEC delivery-artifact Requirement.
The request to reduce spacing so the document fits the page limit belongs to page-limit compliance rather than general layout treatment.
The request to replace two proposal tables belongs to the table-integration Requirement.
The requirement to reduce the letter to one page belongs primarily to the one-page cover-letter Requirement.
The client's successful hyperlink check verifies the hyperlink-functionality Requirement.
The request to zoom out a photo to restore visibility of the tree belongs to photo selection and treatment.
The requested modular table style concerns reuse across future proposals rather than integration of the current RFQ tables.
The client's successful hyperlink check verifies PDF hyperlink functionality rather than the consolidated revision round.
The requested page 11 photo recropping concerns photo treatment rather than whether the consolidated revision pass was provided.

missing_requirement_candidates.description: The client requested independently reusable modular proposal sections and table styles, the freelancer identified this as separate scope, and the client deferred it to a future project.

The client separately requires consistent font types and sizes, while later draft evidence identifies unresolved in-text bold formatting; no typography-specific Requirement exists in the frozen inventory.
